name: apple-mail-mcp
description: Read, search, send and organize Apple Mail, manage Apple Calendar and Apple Notes — locally, with zero dependencies.
long_description: Runs on JavaScript for Automation (osascript), which ships with macOS. No Node, Python or Homebrew. Two tools: `read` (never changes anything) and `write` (send and reply, folders and rules, Trash, calendar events, notes).

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read Apple Mail, Calendar and Notes: accounts, folders, messages, search, rules, calendars, events, notes.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Send and reply to email, organize folders and rules, move to Trash, create/delete events, create/update/delete notes.
